description: Cost-centre hierarchy changes after the data mapping is frozen
mitigation: Agree a freeze date with Finance and put hierarchy edits under change control

description: Reviewers are unavailable when process design needs sign-off
mitigation: Book review slots now and name a deputy for each reviewer

description: Payroll interface specification is not agreed before the build starts
mitigation: Run a joint workshop with the payroll vendor in the first week of November

description: Managers do not adopt the new system after go-live
mitigation: Recruit manager champions and train managers before cutover

description: Legacy HRIS notice deadline falls before cutover is stable
mitigation: Ask the legacy vendor for a short extension option in the renewal talks

description: Legal review of the payroll vendor's data residency terms is still open
mitigation: Escalate to the Head of Legal and write the options paper without that section for now

description: Finance review of mapping v1 missed its date
mitigation: Reschedule the review and ask for a decision on the master cost-centre list

description: The dashboard needs clean headcount data from the migration
mitigation: Use a snapshot extract for the prototype and switch to the HRIS feed after trial load 2

description: The identity provider supports the single sign-on standard the new system needs
mitigation: Confirm in the sandbox test on 3 Nov

description: Performance tool replacement slips past the notice date
mitigation: Decide on the shortlist by end of November and keep a one-year renewal as the fallback

description: Survey history cannot be exported in a usable format
mitigation: Export tested on a sample and the format works

description: The team has about 40 person-days a quarter for automation requests
mitigation: Compare against actual throughput every month and adjust

description: Employee representative consultation adds time in some countries
mitigation: Confirm requirements country by country at the start of process design

description: Old epics clutter the planning board and hide real work
mitigation: Archive rules agreed and the bulk archive is scheduled
